label: end of original / <DEL> in long sequences shortly after a 1 (weak, unexplained)
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.007% of steps). Fires almost only at steps 7-9: the last original tokens and the <DEL> step of length-8/9 sequences (56% of mass at <DEL>, so recall_idx 0); essentially never in the copy phase or before step 3. Strongly enriched when the token 1 is the previous or second-previous input (prev_tok=1 has 18.6x lift), when the sequence holds many digits, and when the first token is e/j/g/v/w/b. These are only soft tendencies: even the best conjunction has about 3-5% precision, with roughly half the activation mass covered. Nothing checked explains the magnitude beyond the top examples, which all have 1 just before <DEL>. No coherent predicate found.
